proofBoundary: These independent source AST findings establish authored call-shape evidence, not execution of receiver-inference.ts or live Minecraft events. A uniquely identified playerSpawn callback supplies a Player source candidate; parser must independently preserve scope, import origin and helper identity. Sound sites are not proof of delivered audio, gameplay outcome or proper cleanup.
genericCounterexamples: PlayerJoinAfterEvent does not carry a Player object; never treat event.player as Player solely by lexical spelling.
Helper with an additional unknown or indirect caller cannot inherit a single type.
An exported helper or a nested same-name local helper is not uniquely owned.
Reassignment or shadowing of event/Player parameter invalidates provenance.
Bundled/minified generic object playSound methods are not automatically Minecraft Player/Dimension APIs.
